'''Hijkata''' was a [[Unarmed combat/Legends|martial arts]] discipline that the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]] were drilled in. It focused on deflecting and countering the attacks of your opponents, turning their attacks and maneuvers against them.
